tools.name: hosttracker_instant_check
tools.description: Run a free, no-login instant website check on host-tracker.com (HTTP availability, page speed, ping, traceroute, port, DNS, DNSBL/RBL blacklist, WHOIS, Russian blacklist, Google Web Risk, SSL certificate, or one-page indexability: noindex, robots.txt and canonical). Navigates the current page to HostTracker's public instant-check page for the given site, which auto-runs the check and renders live results there (this tool does not return the result itself).

url.description: The site address to check, e.g. example.com or https://example.com

type.description: Which check to run. Defaults to check-http (HTTP availability).

tools.name: hosttracker_search_content
tools.description: Search HostTracker's public blog, glossary, or FAQ. Navigates the current page to the matching content-list page with the search query applied (that page loads and filters results itself); this tool does not return search results directly.

section.description: Which content section to search. Defaults to blog.
